reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:96718ed8fcf37c80a1f99bcd360b4a3b]] When I tell u since I bought these makeup brushes my foundation application for my entire face has been hella smooth! I love it! And they are easy to clean, bristles are soooo soft I mean everything is perfect! Definitely worth a buy! Shipping fast too! I have prime so it came literally the next day!

I absolutely love these brushes! If you're looking for makeup brushes, look no further. You will be amazed, wonderful quality for such low price! I promise you you're getting a deal not a rip off. They look just like the pic and the hairs didn't come off...these brushes are incredibly soft. I definitely recommend this brushes if you don't want to spend a ton of money. Very much satisfied with this product!

***this review is my honest opinion and I purchase the product with a shadow palette and primer****  I love the brushes. They are super soft, which is why I gave 4 stars. They are to me, too soft. The eyeshadow brush picks up the shadow easily, but it is a little difficult to apply as the color doesn’t lay down for how much the brush picked up. However, it could also have been the shadows itself, which will begin a separate review.  The foundation brushes are fine and apply my liquid foundation

reviews.t: awesome brush set at an awesome price
reviews.x: I agonized for at least a week over what makeup brush set to buy and I must have looked at 100 of them on amazon.  I did not want to spend a ton of money but I was afraid that if I didn't I would get a crappy brush set and not be happy.  these kept popping up as suggested for me so one day I just clicked the buy now button thinking oh well I can just send them back if I dont like them but let me tell you I am so happy with these brushes.  its the perfect mix of different sizes and different brus

I was so excited to receive these in the mail! I was reading the reviews before I purchased these brushes and I am very content. For such a cheap price, these brushes are so soft and my makeup application with them has been great! I own sigma, morphe, sephora, and mac brushes. They're not HIGH END, but for this price, I can't complain at all. I really love them and use these brushes on the go when I go on vacation and stuff. Not to mention, the colors are so pretty! There is no shedding so far!

I am a makeup newbie. I have always been a tomboy. Makeup just seems very complex to me. I liked the diverse selection of brushes. Even though I might be using them incorrectly, I feel comfortable using these brushes. They are very soft.
Excellent condition of the brushes. Makes my makes up looks smooth and photo ready. They are easy to clean. I’m in love with these brushes, especially for the price.

I purchased these as part of a makeup haul gift set for my sister in law and she really loves them. I only gave them 4 stars, because I'm just not sure how long they will last. I'll update this review after a year.

This was my first time buying a whole set of brushes rather than getting them separately, and I like that this pack includes a brush for every need! It has a little card with pictures of each brush, indicating which is which, but it would be more helpful for a relative novice like me if the brush itself were labeled. The bristles stick together well, so there aren't any weird drag lines, but this also means that the smaller eye brushes need to be broken in a bit.

Love these brushes! They are really soft, and I have love that it has so many to choose from. Would have given 5 stars, but the little description card that came with the set states a makeup sponge is supposed to be included. It wasn't in my package, and I don't see one in other packages that are shown. Would have liked to have received everything I paid for. Bummer...

reviews.t: Nice set but not impressed with the eye brushes
reviews.x: Overall these brushes were a good purchase for the price. I love all the face brushes and this set has everything you need for the face, but I wasn’t super impressed with the eyeshadow brushes or the eyebrow brush. The eyebrow brush isn’t really slim enough to get a nice clean line to make reaslistic hair strokes. Also for me this set doesn’t have a good eyeshadow blending brush and I didn’t find any of the eyeshadow brushes to be super useful. But like I said the face brushes are great and for

If I could give these 0 stars, I would. I have attached a picture so you can see how horrible these brushes are. This is after ONE use! The brush hairs collapsed into the ferrule, and shed everywhere. If you tugged on the brush hair the whole thing popped out of the ferrule. I know they are inexpensive brushes, but I have very inexpensive brush sets that have performed well and held up for years. I do not know how they are so highly rated, unless I just got a bad batch, but I highly doubt that.
I haven't used all the brushes yet but I have used the face brushes they are nice and soft and they don't shed either.

reviews.t: Good product but not a great product.
reviews.x: Neither dislike nor like. The length of all the brushes ( only brushes not the holder) are small . First I thought it’s kids brush set . But while applying the make up ,all the brushes works good.the packing is good.i advice to provide a pouch for this set.For this money , it’s a good product. - reviewed by my wife.

I was a little hesitant buying brushes online for so cheap, but I am really glad I made this decision! The brushes arrived fairly fast and werent damaged at all. They are great quality and are easy to hold. Also the price is amazing. Only about 60 cents per brush, amazing!
I really like these brushes, they are really soft and work great!! They don’t seem like those brushes that fall apart so that great! I am really satisfied with this purchase!
The brushes are good quality and don't shed like some I have used in the past. I would recommend this product.

I was skeptical about these brushes, but decided to go ahead & order because of the good reviews. These did not disappoint! I was mainly looking to add additional eye brushes to my collection, but after seeing this set decided to order it instead. The double ended brush with a spoolie on one end & angled brush on the other worked amazing! I lost my Anastasia brush like that & needed a replacement. I think I like this one even better! I used it to do my eyebrows & line my upper lash with powder.

Honestly I was nervous to buy these since the last brushes I bought off here got rickety and crappy. I will say these brushes are amazing! I got them to apply makeup on clients/friends. They are extremely soft and well made. I am overall happy with the quality they are. They came individually wrapped and then put in bubble wrap. Definitely something I’d purchase again

I was so excited for these brushes but when I got them and opened the bubble pack all you could smell was a strong chemical smell. It honestly smelled like a can of paint. I thought maybe it was the bubble pack and opened the brushes and the brushes smelled even stronger. Very disappointing but I guess you get what you pay for. Returned.
Well made.  Even after washing them (each week) they hold up.. no loose bristles.  A very nice set.
In spanish description Í didnt find that was made of syntetic hair. Though is a good product.
Very nice brushes, only complaint is that the brushes have a very strong chemical smell
I like these makeup brushes a lot. I love how reasonably priced they are.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for!
reviews.x: Wonderful brushes, great deal for the price as well. $0.58 per brush and they work great! This is compared to most stuff on the market where on average, you get only one brush for the same price. Incredibly durable, very soft, and good for everyday use. There are a variety of options for different products. The advantage of having this many brushes is being able to pick and choose your tools in order to create a flawless makeup application. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as very soft and gentle.
Many reviewers consider the set a great value for the low price.
Several reviewers say the brushes are easy to clean and apply makeup smoothly.
A few reviewers report quality issues like shedding, hairs collapsing, or a missing item.
Some reviewers find the eye and eyebrow brushes less effective or the brushes too soft/small.

qa.q: Do the bristles shed or leave hairs on my face?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some report heavy shedding, with brush hairs collapsing into the ferrule and shedding everywhere after one use [1], while others say the brushes don't shed or leave loose bristles, even after weekly washing [3][5][6].

claims.text: One reviewer reports the brush hairs collapsed into the ferrule and shed everywhere after one use [1].
Other reviewers say the brushes don't shed and have no loose bristles, even after weekly washing [3][5][6].

qa.q: Is this brush set good value for the price?
qa.answer: Reviews generally agree the set is good value for the price, with several praising the low per-brush cost and quality [1][3][5]. However, some reviewers describe it as merely a good product for the money rather than a great one [4][6].

claims.text: Reviewers praise the low per-brush cost and quality as good value [1][3][5].
Some reviewers describe it as a good product for the money rather than a great one [4][6].

qa.q: Are the brushes soft and comfortable on sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the brushes as very soft [1][2][3][5][6], but none specifically address use on sensitive skin.

claims.text: The brushes are described as very soft.

qa.q: Does the synthetic bristle material have a strong smell when new?
qa.answer: Yes, some reviewers report a strong chemical smell when the brushes are new [1][2]. One described it as smelling like a can of paint and even stronger after opening the packaging [1].

claims.text: Reviewers report a strong chemical smell when the brushes are new.
One reviewer said it smelled like a can of paint and was even stronger after opening the packaging.

qa.q: Will the handles and ferrules hold up with regular washing?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says the brushes hold up after weekly washing with no loose bristles [1], but another reports the bristles collapsed into the ferrule and popped out after one use [3].

claims.text: The brushes hold up after weekly washing with no loose bristles.
